name: Flowla
description:
Flowla is a digital sales room platform that helps revenue teams create personalised buyer experiences, track engagement, and close deals faster.

With the Flowla MCP connector, Claude can manage your sales rooms in plain language — no code required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Flowla to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Flowla to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.flowla.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Flowla MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flowla lists 42 MCP tools, including create_action_items, create_blocks, create_company, create_form, create_groups, create_pages, create_room, create_sections, delete_action_item, delete_block, delete_group, and delete_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Flowla?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Flowla in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Flowla requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Flowla is developed by Flowla. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
